internal_discovery.plain_explanation: Every one of the three Quranic occurrences of ص خ ر is a noun meaning literally 'rock' — a hard, solid stone mass. It appears as a specific rock beside which travellers shelter (18:63), as the archetype of a sealed, impenetrable place where even a mustard-seed's weight could be hidden (31:16), and as the bedrock hewn by Thamud in the valley (89:9). The only variation is grammatical number/individuation: ṣakhrah names one rock-body, ṣakhr names rock as material. The core meaning 'hard solid rock' is stable across all three; nothing more abstract (e.g. 'hardness of heart') or any verbal/action sense is attested.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: Sxr does NOT entail: (1) any verbal, eventive, process, motion, or sound sense — it is purely substantival (the carving in 89:9 is carried by جَابُوا, not by the root); (2) small, loose, scattered, or throwable stones/pebbles/gravel — every token is a unitary bounded mass or bulk material, and 31:16's imagery specifically requires an impenetrable solid; (3) any abstract or moral valence (impenetrability in 31:16 is a connotation inferred from the object's known hardness, never the denotation; blame in 89:9 attaches to Thamud's act, not the neutral material); (4) 'mountain/elevation' — the rock is sited within terrain (بِٱلْوَادِ in 89:9; contrasted with earth-at-large in 31:16), it is the stone-mass, not the massif. Softness/dust/sand are excluded. No claim of distinctness from جبل or حجر is made — no cross-root evidence is present in this single-root packet.
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: 89:9 (ٱلصَّخْرَ carved/hewn through by humans — rock as workable material) versus 31:16 (صَخْرَةٍ as the humanly-inaccessible ultimate hiding place — impenetrable sealed interior). Surface tension: workable vs. impenetrable. It fails to break the account because both frames presuppose the identical nucleus of hardness: in 31:16 the point is that only Allah retrieves what is sealed within hard rock, and in 89:9 the marvel/hubris is that Thamud managed to cut hard rock. The contrast reinforces rather than fractures the concrete 'hard rock' nucleus; no occurrence materially resists it.
internal_discovery.strongest_competitor: That the nucleus is an abstract property ('hard/immovable solidity, impenetrability') rather than the concrete object, generalizing from 31:16. Rejected: 89:9 (rock hewn to build) and 18:63 (a specific rock used as a shelter-landmark) foreground the object qua material and qua place — carving presupposes a workable substance, not 'impenetrability.' The concrete-object account is both narrower and covers all three tokens; the abstract account over-generalizes from a single case. A secondary competitor — 'two distinct lexemes' (countable ṣakhrah vs. mass ṣakhr) — collapses into standard singulative/collective number alternation over one substance, not two unbridged senses.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Singulative unit noun ṣakhrah = a single discrete, bounded rock-body (boulder). At 18:63 a specific definite rock functioning as a locatable landmark/shelter (أَوَيْنَآ إِلَى ٱلصَّخْرَةِ); at 31:16 an indefinite rock as the epitome of a sealed, dense, impenetrable interior, set in a merism with the heavens and the earth as the exhaustive set of concealment loci.
clusters.classification_rationale: Both bear the -ap (ة) singulative morpheme (S~axorapi, SaxorapK) marking one individuated rock-body, and both denote a concrete solid rock; the impenetrability at 31:16 is inferred from the object's hardness, not a distinct sense. No resistance.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: 18:63 إِذْ أَوَيْنَآ إِلَى ٱلصَّخْرَةِ (definite landmark rock); 31:16 فَتَكُن فِى صَخْرَةٍ contrasted with ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰت and ٱلْأَرْض (sealed solid mass).

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Collective/mass noun ṣakhr = rock as workable bedrock material/substance. At 89:9 the direct object of جَابُوا (hewing/carving), the hard stone-mass Thamud cut in the valley to make dwellings.
clusters.classification_rationale: Bare masculine collective form (S~axora, no -ap, accusative) denoting rock-stuff rather than one body; same substance nucleus as the unit noun, differing only in individuation — a bridged grammatical-number alternation, not a semantic rupture. Occurs only once, so a subtly distinct collective profile cannot be positively excluded, but there is no positive evidence for one.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: 89:9 وَثَمُودَ ٱلَّذِينَ جَابُوا۟ ٱلصَّخْرَ بِٱلْوَادِ — rock as carvable material, sited within the valley (distinct from the elevation itself).

layer_attribution.occurrence_evidence: Three confirmed nominal tokens: 18:63:6:2 (S~axorapi, def. gen. unit noun), 31:16:11:1 (SaxorapK, indef. gen. unit noun), 89:9:4:2 (S~axora, def. acc. collective). All qac_pos=N, qac_verb_form=null, form=N; full_coverage=true.
layer_attribution.derivation: A single tightly-knit nominal derivational family: the classic Arabic collective/nomen-unitatis pair — collective ṣakhr (89:9) alongside unit noun ṣakhrah (18:63, 31:16), differing by the singulative -ap (ة) morpheme. This is grammatical individuation over one substance, not multiple lexemes.
layer_attribution.lexical_class: Wholly lexicalized/nominal: a concrete substantive 'rock'. No verbal, participial, or adjectival form is attested; no productive root-force beyond the concrete object can be demonstrated Quran-internally.
layer_attribution.contextual_relation: Contextual roles — landmark/shelter (18:63), sealed impenetrable concealment-locus in a heavens/earth merism (31:16), carvable bedrock worked by Thamud in the valley (89:9) — are narrative/argumentative functions of the surrounding verses and verbs; they are NOT elevated into the root claim, which remains only 'hard solid rock'.
layer_attribution.reconciliation: The apparent workable-vs-impenetrable tension (89:9 vs 31:16) and the collective-vs-singulative morphological split are both reconciled to one concrete nucleus: differing contexts and grammatical number over the identical substance (hard rock), with impenetrability an inference from the object's hardness. No override or preliminary/final disposition change was needed; all clusters CONSISTENT.
layer_attribution.unresolved_resistance: None. No occurrence materially resists the nucleus and there is no coherent resistant sub-class. What remains genuinely UNRESOLVED (because unattested, not because resistant) is any verbal/participial/productive-abstract semantics of Sxr; the grade is capped at MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE on breadth (n=3, single POS), and any wider root generalization is deliberately excluded.

hard_case_representation.rationale: No occurrence materially resists the concrete 'hard solid rock' nucleus. The apparent tension (89:9 workable/carved rock vs. 31:16 impenetrable sealed rock) both presuppose the same hardness and are absorbed by the nucleus, so it is a challenge that confirms rather than a resistant seam. The singulative/collective split is a bridged grammatical alternation, not an unbridged class. Hence no hard case and no final-RESISTANT occurrence; counterevidence_refs is empty.

rejection_condition.challenging_finding: A Quranic occurrence of Sxr in which the root itself carries a non-rock sense — e.g. a verbal/eventive use, or an abstract/moral 'hardness' denotation not reducible to the physical stone object — thereby showing the concrete-rock nucleus is not the root contribution.
rejection_condition.search_location: The three attested nominal occurrences (18:63:6:2, 31:16:11:1, 89:9:4:2) and specifically the impenetrability framing at 31:16 and the carving framing at 89:9, re-examined to test whether the abstract 'impenetrability' or an eventive sense is denotational rather than an inference from the concrete object.
rejection_condition.verification_method: Confirm qac_pos/qac_verb_form on each token and test whether the sense survives when the physical rock referent is removed; check whether any purported abstract/verbal meaning is supplied by the surrounding verb (e.g. جَابُوا, أَوَيْنَآ) rather than by the root morpheme.
rejection_condition.confounder_control: Attribute carving/refuge/hiding actions to their governing verbs and prepositions, not to Sxr; separate the singulative/collective morphological alternation (individuation) from any claimed semantic shift; do not import lexicon/tafsir 'hardness of heart' senses as they are not Quran-internally attested for this root.
rejection_condition.failure_consequence: If such a finding is verified, the concrete-object nucleus would be downgraded from PREFERRED to UNRESOLVED (multi-class or abstract-vs-concrete split), and the DERIVATIONAL_FAMILY claim retracted in favor of UNRESOLVED_CLASS_ONLY.

reopen_conditions: If a previously unconfirmed occurrence of Sxr with a verbal form (qac_verb_form non-null) or a participial/adjectival form is added to the packet, reopen to test whether the root carries a productive non-nominal sense beyond the concrete 'rock' object.

If a further collective ṣakhr occurrence beyond 89:9 appears, reopen to test whether the collective carries a semantic profile distinct from the unit noun ṣakhrah (18:63, 31:16), since the collective is currently attested only once.

If any occurrence is found where ṣakhr/ṣakhrah denotes an abstract 'hardness/impenetrability' independent of a physical rock referent, reopen the concrete-object nucleus as a possible abstract-vs-concrete split (currently only inferred at 31:16).
